college_info.name: Guru Daksh Government Polytechnic, Hisar
college_info.note: Guru Daksh Government Polytechnic, Hisar (Haryana) - established 1992, under the Department of Technical Education, Government of Haryana. Spread across approximately 40 acres, offering 13 diploma courses to about 3000 students.

entries.question: How do I apply for admission to the diploma course?
entries.answer: Admissions to diploma courses are done through the state polytechnic counselling process. Details such as the Diploma Prospectus, Key Dates, Admission Form, Online Registration, Counselling schedule and Seat Allotment are available on the official college website. You need to register on the counselling portal, fill in your choices, and report to the allotted college with original documents within the given deadline.

entries.question: What is the eligibility criteria for admission?
entries.answer: Candidates who have passed Class 10th (or equivalent) with Science and Mathematics are generally eligible. Exact percentage cut-offs depend on the counselling round and category, so check the latest counselling brochure on the official website.

entries.question: What documents are required at the time of admission?
entries.answer: Usually you need your 10th marksheet, category certificate (if applicable), residence proof, transfer certificate, character certificate, passport-size photographs, and the counselling allotment letter. Please carry both originals and photocopies.

entries.question: What is the fee structure for admission?
entries.answer: The fee structure varies slightly every academic year and by category (general/reserved). Please check the official fee notice on the college notice board or website, or confirm with the accounts office.

entries.question: Where can I find the latest admission notices?
entries.answer: Admission notices for the current academic year (2026-27), including Key Dates, Online Registration and Seat Allotment updates, are published on the official college website. Please check it regularly during the admission season.

entries.question: Which diploma branches are offered at the college?
entries.answer: The college offers 13 diploma courses: Civil Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Fashion Design, Fashion Technology, Finance Account & Auditing, Instrumentation & Control Engineering, Medical Electronics, Textile Design, Textile Processing, and Textile Technology.

entries.question: What is the duration of the diploma course?
entries.answer: The diploma course is generally a 3-year program divided into 6 semesters.

entries.question: How is the semester system structured?
entries.answer: The diploma is spread across 6 semesters, with each semester covering a fixed set of theory and practical subjects as per the state board of technical education syllabus.

entries.question: Does the college offer textile and fashion related diplomas?
entries.answer: Yes, the college offers Fashion Design, Fashion Technology, Textile Design, Textile Processing, and Textile Technology as diploma courses.

entries.question: Where can I find the exam date sheet?
entries.answer: The date sheet is released on the official board/college website before every semester exam and is also displayed on the notice board. Please check both regularly closer to exam time.

entries.question: How can I check my semester result?
entries.answer: Results are usually published on the HSBTE (state technical education board) official website. You will need your roll number to check your result online.

entries.question: What if I fail in a subject?
entries.answer: If you do not clear a subject, you can appear for the reappear/supplementary exam in the next available exam cycle as per HSBTE rules.

entries.question: What is the minimum attendance required to sit in exams?
entries.answer: Most polytechnic institutions require a minimum of 75% attendance in each subject to be eligible to appear in the semester exam. Please confirm the exact figure with your class coordinator.

entries.question: Where is the Exam Branch and how do I get help with my DMC or diploma?
entries.answer: The Exam Branch is located in B-Block, Ground Floor, and handles examinations, results, DMCs (Detailed Marks Cards) and other diploma-related assistance. The institute's HSBTE Exam Nodal Centre Code is 4.

entries.question: What are the library timings?
entries.answer: The library is generally open on all working days during college hours. For exact timings and book issue rules, please check with the librarian.

entries.question: Does the college provide hostel facility?
entries.answer: Yes, the campus has separate Boys' and Girls' Hostels along with a Guest House for visitors.

entries.question: What lab and workshop facilities are available?
entries.answer: The campus has well-equipped classrooms, laboratories and workshops for all departments, including a CNC Lab, along with computer labs for programming, networking and project work as per the semester's practical syllabus.

entries.question: Is Wi-Fi available on campus?
entries.answer: Yes, free high-speed Wi-Fi is available across the campus.

entries.question: What sports facilities are available on campus?
entries.answer: The campus has a Gymnasium, a Football/Cricket ground, and Basketball & Volleyball courts for students.

entries.question: Is there a canteen on campus?
entries.answer: Yes, the campus has a Canteen and a Vita Booth for students.

entries.question: Is the campus secure?
entries.answer: Yes, the campus is under CCTV surveillance for student safety, and first-aid facilities are also available.

entries.question: Is there a place for student activities and events?
entries.answer: Yes, the campus has a Students' Activity Centre for extracurricular activities and events.

entries.question: Who is the Head of Department for Computer Engineering?
entries.answer: Please check the department notice board or the college website for the current Head of Department, as this can change over time.

entries.question: How can I contact my subject teacher?
entries.answer: You can meet your subject teacher during their free periods in the department, or reach out through the class WhatsApp/Google Classroom group if one has been created for your batch.

entries.question: Which departments does the college have?
entries.answer: The college has faculty across departments including Applied Science, Civil Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Textile, and Fashion. Department-wise faculty details are available on the official college website.

entries.question: Where is the college located?
entries.answer: The college, Guru Daksh Government Polytechnic, is located in Hisar, Haryana. For the exact address and directions, please check the official college website.

entries.question: What is the contact number of the college office?
entries.answer: Please refer to the official college website or notice board for the current administrative office contact number, as this is updated from time to time.

entries.question: What should I do if I lose my ID card?
entries.answer: Report the loss to your class coordinator and the administration office. You will usually need to submit a written application and a small fee to get a duplicate ID card issued.

entries.question: Tell me about the college and when it was established.
entries.answer: Guru Daksh Government Polytechnic, Hisar is run under the Department of Technical Education, Government of Haryana. The institute was established in 1992 and is spread across approximately 40 acres, offering 13 diploma courses to around 3000 students.

entries.question: How big is the college campus?
entries.answer: The campus is spread across approximately 40 acres.

entries.question: How many students study at the college?
entries.answer: The institute has approximately 3000 students enrolled across its 13 diploma courses.
